subject.title: fix(codex): cap compaction override warning cache via createDedupeCache

question: Should the Codex ignored-compaction-override warning cache switch from process-lifetime warn-once to a 4096-entry LRU cap despite the related cache-cap rejection?
rationale: The code and proof are adequate if the cap is desired, but accepting possible re-warnings after eviction is an owner lifecycle decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Require Codex owner approval before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open until a Codex owner explicitly accepts the 4096-key eviction lifecycle for this warning cache, then rebase and merge if checks pass.

options.title: Accept the bounded cache now
options.body: Merge the narrow helper-backed cap based on the production-path proof, accepting that very high-cardinality configurations can re-emit warnings after eviction.

options.title: Close as defensive churn
options.body: Close without merging if maintainers apply the same no-arbitrary-cache-caps policy used on the related plugin-runtime cache PR.

recommendation.title: Require Codex owner approval before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a Codex owner explicitly accepts the 4096-key eviction lifecycle for this warning cache, then rebase and merge if checks pass.
